issues.title: Investigate intermittent cold-refresh market and account bootstrap failures
issues.scope: Capture timings and safe status codes on recurrence; the reported login state and root cause remain unconfirmed. Use disposable accounts; do not clear user storage or replay writes.
acceptance: Record authenticated cold, warm and delayed-response behavior separately.
Identify a reproducible cause or document inconclusive evidence and next diagnostic boundary.
Any proposed read retry preserves owner isolation and explicit unavailable/stale states.

issues.title: Investigate published catalog availability during ingestion
issues.scope: Trace why fallback was observed while ingestion ran. Reproduce with fixtures before considering any database operation; no repair or live ingestion is authorized by this issue.
acceptance: Explain published versus incomplete run visibility with evidence.
Test that incomplete runs cannot become current and last-good availability remains honest.

issues.title: Record human production acceptance without weakening Cloudflare security
issues.scope: Distinguish production-preview/API checks from a real custom-domain sign-in. This is not the separately deferred physical recovery test.
acceptance: Record provider sign-in, linked-method and administrator badge checks using a disposable permitted account.
Keep managed challenge/security rules unchanged; state any verification limitation.

issues.title: Review production rollout readiness for the compact auction catalog
issues.evidence: Staging must preserve its existing compact-catalog flag
issues.scope: Reconcile older rollout notes with latest staging evidence; this issue is a decision gate, not approval to enable production.
acceptance: Record current environment flags and exact versioned printing parity.
Compare cold/warm request count, payload, latency and fallback behavior.
Document rollout and rollback conditions and obtain explicit production authorization.

issues.title: Decide new Pokémon rarity sections and heatmap aggregation
issues.scope: Review Pikachu Rare, Futuristic Rare, RGB Rare and Classic Collection explicitly. Never map a new label silently to an unrelated rarity.
acceptance: Approve section and heatmap mapping rules with examples.
Keep missing prices, history and uncurated pull rates unavailable.
Add classification tests before any reviewed feed regeneration.

issues.title: Align Radiance presale policy between bundled generation and live ingestion
issues.scope: Compare future-set eligibility rules; choose a shared policy before refreshing any external feeds.
acceptance: Explain the bundled/live discrepancy using fixtures.
Agree on presale inclusion and provenance labels.
Document source-refresh authorization and generated-diff checks separately.

issues.title: Consolidate retailer-exclusive sealed classification audit
issues.scope: Reconcile duplicate L4/M13 proposals and audit explicit product variants, displays and cases without broad name-based merging.
acceptance: Create a reviewed representative fixture set and deliberate classification rules.
Preserve multi-unit ordering, release variants and cross-market exclusion.

issues.title: Plan append-only sales corrections and refunds
issues.scope: Retain original sale allocations; separate corrections from physical returns. Resume only when reprioritized.
acceptance: Specify original sale linkage, reason, timestamp, revision and preview.
Prove quantity/cost conservation and no duplicated stock on retries or conflicts.
Never reconstruct missing legacy grouping from names or dates.

issues.title: Plan collection transfers preserving dated lots and baselines
issues.scope: Move holdings without turning transfers into market gains or breaking sale references. Resume only when reprioritized.
acceptance: Specify atomic revision checks and provenance across source/destination.
Verify quantities, purchase cost, dates, baselines and review movers remain correct.

issues.title: Plan previewed bulk sticker-price edits
issues.scope: Change asking prices only, not market prices or performance. Revisit storage constraints before scaling.
acceptance: Specify selection scope and preview with missing-value handling.
Use all-or-nothing revision checks and conflict recovery.
Keep market/baseline and sold history unchanged.

issues.title: Plan non-destructive collection archiving
issues.scope: Retain sales and audit history; define which collections may be archived before implementation.
acceptance: Specify archive/unarchive eligibility and overview behavior.
Prove no lost sale references, holdings or event history.

issues.title: Review account privacy, private backup retention and deletion policy
issues.scope: Document current retention boundaries and obtain decisions before deleting backups or changing production behavior. Do not attach real exports.
acceptance: Describe identity versus environment-save retention and recovery access.
Define backup expiry/deletion exceptions and evidence without publishing personal data.
Identify any policy or implementation follow-up separately.

issues.title: Define deletion-outbox monitoring and operational acceptance
issues.scope: Use synthetic events and aggregate health signals; no real deletion or new monitoring service is authorized.
acceptance: Define pending-age, retry and terminal-failure visibility with owner-safe access.
Exercise retry/idempotency and a documented escalation path using fixtures.

issues.title: Reconcile October model-review commitments with actual evidence
issues.scope: The source date has passed; verify whether the review happened before calling it overdue. No automatic model promotion or new data refresh.
acceptance: Link existing verdicts or record genuinely missing evidence.
Document scoreboard, data-health and frozen-parameter review requirements.
Keep v1 champion until an explicit evidence-backed promotion decision.

issues.title: Specify model-version history stamping before a future promotion
issues.scope: Verify writer/schema gaps and define an additive version marker; preserve legacy unavailable values rather than fabricating a historical version.
acceptance: Trace current signal-history writes and schema before proposing migration.
Test champion/shadow version attribution and idempotent history writes.
Keep schema deployment/migration separately authorized.

issues.title: Scope the human-reviewed Editorial Queue first release
issues.scope: Separate Pokémon/Riftbound recaps, data-led analysis and labeled editorial outlook. Local article drafts are not approved for publication or import into GitHub.
acceptance: Define draft/review/publish permissions, source evidence and correction handling.
Plan Monday weekly and first-of-month monthly drafts in Eastern time without activating jobs.
Require human publication approval; no automatic market predictions or article publishing.

issues.title: Deferred: Optional Module Budget
issues.evidence: Optional Module Budget — deferred by user
issues.scope: No reminder or due date. Resume only when reprioritized and measurable initial-download/CPU benefit justifies splitting.
acceptance: Preserve first-click responsiveness, editor state, accessible retries and old-tab behavior.
Do not split core data, timers or save logic for marginal chunk savings.

issues.title: Deferred: Physical Recovery Testing
issues.evidence: Physical Recovery Testing — deferred by user
issues.scope: Await available hardware and reprioritization; no reminder or due date. Desktop Chrome/Firefox plus physical mobile Safari remains distinct from automated tests.
acceptance: Cover offline conflicts, lost accepted-write responses, session expiry, reopen/export and wrong-owner isolation.
Prove no duplicated cash/inventory or lost progress; do not call emulation physical verification.

issues.title: Deferred: Populated Account Acceptance
issues.evidence: Populated Account Acceptance — deferred by user
issues.scope: No reminder or due date. Resume with disposable large fixtures, never personal inventories.
acceptance: Check holdings/import/favorites pagination, rendering cost and pending-save recovery.
Keep existing privacy/save regression checks and distinguish this from physical Safari acceptance.

issues.title: Discovery: public-only Auction House multiplayer
issues.scope: Future planning only: public matchmaking, no private rooms/codes. Do not provision infrastructure.
acceptance: Specify authoritative bids/timers, reconnects, NPC fill and separate multiplayer economy.
Identify abuse, disconnect and fairness boundaries before implementation.

issues.title: Discovery: staging-only developer mode authorization and data boundaries
issues.scope: Document useful diagnostics before implementation; existing accounts/admin roles do not authorize hidden production data access.
acceptance: Specify default-off admin-only staging controls and redacted hidden-game diagnostics.
Prove server authorization and production exclusion; no secrets or other users' private data exposed.
